# Agent setup brief

Outcome: Marketing content
Existing agent: Claude Code
Priority: A small, working first version
Vision: <img src=x onerror="window.__unsafe=1"> calm ceramics campaign
Constraints: No new subscriptions; synthetic assets only

## Suggested capabilities
- Doc Coauthoring (Anthropic): Structure a proposal or document through context gathering, drafting and reader checks.
  Source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills/doc-coauthoring/SKILL.md
  Evidence: Source reviewed; installation and performance untested

## Requirements to confirm
- Agent able to follow the documented writing workflow
- Source context and a clear document purpose

## Working approach
1. Inspect the linked source and ask how to provide it as explicit context in your agent. Native installation is not assumed.
2. Describe the desired output and boundaries. Do not install tools, spend or publish without explicit permission.
3. Make a small version in a separate working copy.
4. Run the checklist and report what actually passed.

## Readiness and acceptance
- [ ] Confirm your agent can read the selected source and project files.
- [ ] Review the current source, licence, dependencies and permissions before running anything.
- [ ] Use a copy or a new practice folder; keep the original files.
- [ ] Agree on a small acceptance checklist before making changes.
- [ ] Check the actual output and record failures, costs and remaining limits.
- [ ] Check every factual claim against its source; review brand voice and usage rights.
